title: Loot Stack - Relics Hunter
description:
Loot Stack: Relics Hunter is a relaxing yet strategic inventory management puzzle where every relic has a unique shape and every slot matters. Explore medieval dungeons, uncover hidden treasures, and optimize your grid to collect them all.

 

🧩 Optimize your inventory
Arrange relics of different shapes and sizes, rotate them, and make the most of limited space.

🏰 Explore handcrafted medieval scenarios
Search through atmospheric dungeons filled with hidden items and valuable treasures.

🎯 Challenging but cozy gameplay
Easy to learn, satisfying to master. Perfect for players who enjoy relaxing puzzle experiences.

📦 Backpack-style inventory mechanics
Inspired by classic inventory puzzles — fit everything efficiently to maximize rewards.

🔍 Discover hidden relics
Each level contains secrets waiting to be uncovered and perfectly organized.

Key Features• Relaxing inventory management puzzle

• 25 handcrafted scenarios

• Unique relic shapes to fit and organize

• Cozy medieval dungeon atmosphere

• Strategic grid-based gameplay

• Hidden items and collectibles

• Satisfying optimization mechanics
description_short: Relaxing inventory management puzzle set in medieval dungeons. Organize, stack, and fit uniquely shaped relics, optimize your grid, and collect hidden treasures across 25 handcrafted scenarios.
